title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

series.title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

fullText.simplified:
一、这是哪儿？

    这是什么地方？米乐往旁边看了看，他不认识这里。米乐又用鼻子闻了闻，他没来过这个地方。米乐有点儿害怕，他动了动四条腿，开始慢慢地往前走。这个地方真奇怪，没有房子，也没有车。很多人都在往前走，米乐不知道该去哪里，只能跟着人们往前走……
    这是哪儿？我是怎么来到这个地方的？虽然米乐努力地想着，但是他的头很疼，他不知道发生了什么。米乐只想起了一些事情：他和主人季南一起玩球；他饿了，他在等季南给他牛肉块；他和季南在河里游泳……游泳？然后……米乐的头特别疼，然后发生了什么？他想不起来了。
    米乐又看了看身边，没有季南。他的主人去哪儿了？他们一起去游泳，然后季南去哪儿了？米乐有点儿着急，他开始小跑了起来。他往前跑了跑，没看见季南。他用鼻子闻了闻，也没有季南。他想：“一定是我跑得太快了。”米乐决定往回跑，他要回去找季南。米乐从人们的腿边跑过，大家都奇怪地看向他。米乐不明白为什么每个人都在看自己。
    一个女人站在了米乐的前面，米乐看了看女人。她看起来不太好，脸色很白。她身上的衣服米乐见过，在哪儿见过呢？医院？应该是医院，以前季南住院的时候也穿过这样的衣服。
    女人把手放在米乐的头上，对米乐说：“大金毛，你也来这里了，你叫什么名字啊？”
    “我叫米乐。请问这儿是什么地方？”米乐说道。
    女人听不懂米乐的话，她只听见米乐叫了两声。
fullText.traditional:
一、這是哪兒？

    這是什麼地方？米樂往旁邊看了看，他不認識這裡。米樂又用鼻子聞了聞，他沒來過這個地方。米樂有點兒害怕，他動了動四條腿，開始慢慢地往前走。這個地方真奇怪，沒有房子，也沒有車。很多人都在往前走，米樂不知道該去哪裡，只能跟著人們往前走……
    這是哪兒？我是怎麼來到這個地方的？雖然米樂努力地想著，但是他的頭很疼，他不知道發生了什麼。米樂只想起了一些事情：他和主人季南一起玩球；他餓了，他在等季南給他牛肉塊；他和季南在河裡游泳……游泳？然後……米樂的頭特別疼，然後發生了什麼？他想不起來了。
    米樂又看了看身邊，沒有季南。他的主人去哪兒了？他們一起去游泳，然後季南去哪兒了？米樂有點兒著急，他開始小跑了起來。他往前跑了跑，沒看見季南。他用鼻子聞了聞，也沒有季南。他想：“一定是我跑得太快了。”米樂決定往回跑，他要回去找季南。米樂從人們的腿邊跑過，大家都奇怪地看向他。米樂不明白為什麼每個人都在看自己。
    一個女人站在了米樂的前面，米樂看了看女人。她看起來不太好，臉色很白。她身上的衣服米樂見過，在哪兒見過呢？醫院？應該是醫院，以前季南住院的時候也穿過這樣的衣服。
    女人把手放在米樂的頭上，對米樂說：“大金毛，你也來這裡了，你叫什麼名字啊？”
    “我叫米樂。請問這兒是什麼地方？”米樂說道。
    女人聽不懂米樂的話，她只聽見米樂叫了兩聲。

sentences.traditional: 這是什麼地方？米樂往旁邊看了看，他不認識這裡。

sentences.english: What was this place? Mi Le looked to the side. He did not recognize it here.

sentences.simplified: 米乐又用鼻子闻了闻，他没来过这个地方。
sentences.traditional: 米樂又用鼻子聞了聞，他沒來過這個地方。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè yòu yòng bí zi wén le wén tā méi lái guò zhè ge dì fang
sentences.english: Mi Le also sniffed with his nose. He had never been to this place.

sentences.simplified: 米乐有点儿害怕，他动了动四条腿，开始慢慢地往前走。
sentences.traditional: 米樂有點兒害怕，他動了動四條腿，開始慢慢地往前走。

sentences.english: Mi Le was a little scared. He moved his four legs and began to walk slowly forward.

sentences.simplified: 这个地方真奇怪，没有房子，也没有车。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方真奇怪，沒有房子，也沒有車。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge dì fang zhēn qí guài méi yǒu fáng zi yě méi yǒu chē
sentences.english: This was a strange place. There were no houses and no cars.

sentences.simplified: 很多人都在往前走，米乐不知道该去哪里，只能跟着人们往前走……
sentences.traditional: 很多人都在往前走，米樂不知道該去哪裡，只能跟著人們往前走……
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō rén dōu zài wǎng qián zǒu mǐ lè bù zhī dào gāi qù nǎ lǐ zhǐ néng gēn zhe rén men wǎng qián zǒu
sentences.english: Many people were walking forward. Mi Le did not know where to go. He could only follow the people forward …

sentences.simplified: 这是哪儿？我是怎么来到这个地方的？
sentences.traditional: 這是哪兒？我是怎麼來到這個地方的？
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì nǎ'r wǒ shì zěn me lái dào zhè ge dì fang de
sentences.english: Where is this? How did I get to this place?

sentences.simplified: 虽然米乐努力地想着，但是他的头很疼，他不知道发生了什么。
sentences.traditional: 雖然米樂努力地想著，但是他的頭很疼，他不知道發生了什麼。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán mǐ lè nǔ lì de xiǎng zhe dàn shì tā de tóu hěn téng tā bù zhī dào fā shēng le shén me
sentences.english: Although Mi Le thought hard, his head hurt, and he had no idea what was going on.

sentences.simplified: 米乐只想起了一些事情：他和主人季南一起玩球；
sentences.traditional: 米樂只想起了一些事情：他和主人季南一起玩球；

sentences.english: Mi Le only remembered a few things: He was playing ball with his owner, Ji Nan.

sentences.simplified: 他饿了，他在等季南给他牛肉块；
sentences.traditional: 他餓了，他在等季南給他牛肉塊；
sentences.pinyin: tā è le tā zài děng jì nán gěi tā niú ròu kuài
sentences.english: He was hungry and waiting for Ji Nan to give him pieces of beef.

sentences.simplified: 他和季南在河里游泳……游泳？
sentences.traditional: 他和季南在河裡游泳……游泳？
sentences.pinyin: tā hé jì nán zài hé lǐ yóu yǒng yóu yǒng
sentences.english: He and Ji Nan were swimming in the river … swimming?

sentences.simplified: 然后……米乐的头特别疼，然后发生了什么？他想不起来了。
sentences.traditional: 然後……米樂的頭特別疼，然後發生了什麼？他想不起來了。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu mǐ lè de tóu tè bié téng rán hòu fā shēng le shén me tā xiǎng bù qǐ lái le
sentences.english: Then … Mi Le’s head hurt so much. Then what happened? He couldn’t remember anything else.

sentences.simplified: 米乐又看了看身边，没有季南。他的主人去哪儿了？
sentences.traditional: 米樂又看了看身邊，沒有季南。他的主人去哪兒了？
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè yòu kàn le kàn shēn biān méi yǒu jì nán tā de zhǔ rén qù nǎ'r le
sentences.english: Mi Le looked around again, and there was no Ji Nan. Where did his owner go?

sentences.simplified: 他们一起去游泳，然后季南去哪儿了？
sentences.traditional: 他們一起去游泳，然後季南去哪兒了？
sentences.pinyin: tā men yì qǐ qù yóu yǒng rán hòu jì nán qù nǎ'r le
sentences.english: They went swimming together, and then where did Ji Nan go?

sentences.simplified: 米乐有点儿着急，他开始小跑了起来。他往前跑了跑，没看见季南。
sentences.traditional: 米樂有點兒著急，他開始小跑了起來。他往前跑了跑，沒看見季南。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè yǒu diǎn'r zháo jí tā kāi shǐ xiǎo pǎo le qǐ lái tā wǎng qián pǎo le pǎo méi kàn jiàn jì nán
sentences.english: Mi Le was a little anxious, and he started trotting. He ran forward. He did not see Ji Nan.

sentences.simplified: 他用鼻子闻了闻，也没有季南。他想：“一定是我跑得太快了。”
sentences.traditional: 他用鼻子聞了聞，也沒有季南。他想：“一定是我跑得太快了。”
sentences.pinyin: tā yòng bí zi wén le wén yě méi yǒu jì nán tā xiǎng yí dìng shì wǒ pǎo de tài kuài le
sentences.english: He sniffed with his nose, and there was no Ji Nan. He thought, “I must be running too fast.”

sentences.simplified: 米乐决定往回跑，他要回去找季南。
sentences.traditional: 米樂決定往回跑，他要回去找季南。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè jué dìng wǎng huí pǎo tā yào huí qù zhǎo jì nán
sentences.english: Mi Le decided to run back. He had to go back to Ji Nan.

sentences.simplified: 米乐从人们的腿边跑过，大家都奇怪地看向他。米乐不明白为什么每个人都在看自己。
sentences.traditional: 米樂從人們的腿邊跑過，大家都奇怪地看向他。米樂不明白為什麼每個人都在看自己。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè cóng rén men de tuǐ biān pǎo guò dà jiā dōu qí guài de kàn xiàng tā mǐ lè bù míng bai wèi shén me měi ge rén dōu zài kàn zì jǐ
sentences.english: Mi Le ran past people’s legs, and they all looked at him strangely. Mi Le didn’t understand why everyone was looking at him.

sentences.simplified: 一个女人站在了米乐的前面，米乐看了看女人。她看起来不太好，脸色很白。
sentences.traditional: 一個女人站在了米樂的前面，米樂看了看女人。她看起來不太好，臉色很白。
sentences.pinyin: yí ge nǚ rén zhàn zài le mǐ lè de qián miàn mǐ lè kàn le kàn nǚ rén tā kàn qǐ lái bú tài hǎo liǎn sè hěn bái
sentences.english: A woman stood in front of Mi Le, and Mi Le looked at the woman. She didn’t look well. She looked very pale.

sentences.simplified: 她身上的衣服米乐见过，在哪儿见过呢？
sentences.traditional: 她身上的衣服米樂見過，在哪兒見過呢？
sentences.pinyin: tā shēn shang de yī fu mǐ lè jiàn guò zài nǎ'r jiàn guò ne
sentences.english: Mi Le had seen clothes like she was wearing before. Where had he seen them?

sentences.simplified: 医院？应该是医院，以前季南住院的时候也穿过这样的衣服。
sentences.traditional: 醫院？應該是醫院，以前季南住院的時候也穿過這樣的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: yī yuàn yīng gāi shì yī yuàn yǐ qián jì nán zhù yuàn de shí hou yě chuān guò zhè yàng de yī fu
sentences.english: The hospital? It must be the hospital. Ji Nan had also worn such clothes when he was at the hospital before.

sentences.simplified: 女人把手放在米乐的头上，对米乐说：“大金毛，你也来这里了，你叫什么名字啊？”
sentences.traditional: 女人把手放在米樂的頭上，對米樂說：“大金毛，你也來這裡了，你叫什麼名字啊？”
sentences.pinyin: nǚ rén bǎ shǒu fàng zài mǐ lè de tóu shang duì mǐ lè shuō dà jīn máo nǐ yě lái zhè lǐ le nǐ jiào shén me míng zi a
sentences.english: The woman put her hand on Mi Le’s head and said to Mi Le, “Big Goldie, you’re here too. What’s your name?”

sentences.simplified: “我叫米乐。请问这儿是什么地方？”米乐说道。
sentences.traditional: “我叫米樂。請問這兒是什麼地方？”米樂說道。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jiào mǐ lè qǐng wèn zhè‘r shì shén me dì fang mǐ lè shuō dào
sentences.english: “My name is Mi Le. Please tell me, what is this place?” Mi Le said.

sentences.simplified: 女人听不懂米乐的话，她只听见米乐叫了两声。
sentences.traditional: 女人聽不懂米樂的話，她只聽見米樂叫了兩聲。
sentences.pinyin: nǚ rén tīng bù dǒng mǐ lè de huà tā zhǐ tīng jiàn mǐ lè jiào le liǎng shēng
sentences.english: The woman couldn’t understand what Mi Le said. She only heard Mi Le bark twice.

sentence_translations: (1) Where Is This?
What was this place? Mi Le looked to the side. He did not recognize it here.
Mi Le also sniffed with his nose. He had never been to this place.
Mi Le was a little scared. He moved his four legs and began to walk slowly forward.
This was a strange place. There were no houses and no cars.
Many people were walking forward. Mi Le did not know where to go. He could only follow the people forward …
Where is this? How did I get to this place?
Although Mi Le thought hard, his head hurt, and he had no idea what was going on.
Mi Le only remembered a few things: He was playing ball with his owner, Ji Nan.
He was hungry and waiting for Ji Nan to give him pieces of beef.
He and Ji Nan were swimming in the river … swimming?
Then … Mi Le’s head hurt so much. Then what happened? He couldn’t remember anything else.
Mi Le looked around again, and there was no Ji Nan. Where did his owner go?
They went swimming together, and then where did Ji Nan go?
Mi Le was a little anxious, and he started trotting. He ran forward. He did not see Ji Nan.
He sniffed with his nose, and there was no Ji Nan. He thought, “I must be running too fast.”
Mi Le decided to run back. He had to go back to Ji Nan.
Mi Le ran past people’s legs, and they all looked at him strangely. Mi Le didn’t understand why everyone was looking at him.
A woman stood in front of Mi Le, and Mi Le looked at the woman. She didn’t look well. She looked very pale.
Mi Le had seen clothes like she was wearing before. Where had he seen them?
The hospital? It must be the hospital. Ji Nan had also worn such clothes when he was at the hospital before.
The woman put her hand on Mi Le’s head and said to Mi Le, “Big Goldie, you’re here too. What’s your name?”
“My name is Mi Le. Please tell me, what is this place?” Mi Le said.
The woman couldn’t understand what Mi Le said. She only heard Mi Le bark twice.
